bestBets.overview: GLOUF was competitive in a BM72 last start, great form for a Saturday provincial maiden. SPICY APPLE has been racing over a bit more ground but is hard fit and close to a win. AFFINEDEEL was ok when resuming for a new stable and looks ready for this step up in distance. BOUCHEREIGN ended up a long way back at debut and will be better for the experience; another likely to be suited by the 1900m.

raceTips.comment: Glouf is easy to mark as favourite given his last start performance in a Saturday metropolitan race in Adelaide, where he worked to the line well and placed third to Centu Cavaddi. It seems connections have sent him up to Mildura for an easy kill and he will be awfully hard to beat. Where Eagles Dare could be the big improver on a dry track after struggling on wet in his past two starts. The rise in distance third-up is also beneficial. Spicy Apple has been consistent without winning in maidens at this distance range and should be competitive again.

bestBets.overview: ATTAIN ran well in a stronger contest here two starts ago, tried in town last time. BOW RIBBON is still on the one win but he was good in similar company at Echuca with a big gap to third there. PHOEBE BUFFAY strips hard fit for recent outings and won't be Friend-less in the betting. HYDROGEN POWER is back in trip but has been thereabouts of late. LIMBERING still racing well at nine. FLIGHT DECK hasn't won for a while but is down in grade.

raceTips.comment: Speed likely to be genuine with several noted on-pace runners engaged. Phoebe Buffay maps to get a sweet run just behind the leaders from the inside draw and is well graded in this class. Attain ran well first-up for the new stable during the Mildura Cup carnival and can improve returning to his home track. This is the easiest race he has contested for quite some time.

bestBets.overview: STYLISH SPARKLE has some x-factor having looked good swamping rivals at debut; just even at second go but tried in stakes class last time out. New stable for BAKERSBEND who has run very well at both first up attempts. BOWER BOY has also had a trainer change and is also capable of running nicely fresh. DECANTED just keeps racing well. ORTHIE'S BOY has not been far away contesting stronger races of late and is proven over this shorter trip. MAGESTIC DIVA usually races well here.

raceTips.comment: Decanted has the natural speed to push forward from the wide draw and lead. He was brave in defeat when racing on-pace at Murtoa last start and should be tough run down if he can find the front. Orthie's Boy held his own in a much stronger race at Morphettville last start and can improve here back in class. Bakersbend showed a lot of promise early last preparation and maps for a dream run just behind the leaders. Just might be a case of whether he is as fit as some of his rivals.
